verdict.rationale: This is an AI agent that taps and types on a real iPhone, so approval gates before sensitive actions are a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions any confirmation or approval step before payments, sends or deletes. The only documented pause comes from a lost board, hotspot or mirroring link, which is a connectivity recovery feature, not an operator approval gate.

support.subject: As an operator, sensitive actions (payments, sends, deletes) pause for my approval before the agent executes them
